'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Schmaltz LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Schmaltz]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' dashmudtz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
